related.title: NVIDIA Blackwell 多晶粒 GPU
related.why: 可遷移張量、數值誤差及計算／記憶體收支；算子、精度與資料歸納假設需重設。
related.whyEn: Tensor, numerical-error and compute/memory accounting transfer while operators, precision and data assumptions must be respecified.
related.transfer: 可遷移張量、數值誤差及計算／記憶體收支；算子、精度與資料歸納假設需重設。
related.transferEn: Tensor, numerical-error and compute/memory accounting transfer while operators, precision and data assumptions must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課針對SIMT、Transformer Engine 與非同步記憶體；NVIDIA Blackwell 多晶粒 GPU改以多晶粒互連、低精度矩陣與機架擴充為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on simt, transformer engine and asynchronous memory; NVIDIA Blackwell multi-die GPU centers on die interconnects, low-precision matrices and rack scaling, so geometry, boundaries and product values cannot transfer unchanged.
practice: 對照Hopper warp與SM與Blackwell SM與調度，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。
把本課假想算例移到NVIDIA Blackwell 多晶粒 GPU，列出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以工作能耗與精度為起點，設計一項能區分「SIMT、Transformer Engine 與非同步記憶體」與「多晶粒互連、低精度矩陣與機架擴充」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare hopper warps and sms with blackwell sms and scheduling and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to NVIDIA Blackwell multi-die GPU, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from job energy and precision and propose an observation distinguishing simt, transformer engine and asynchronous memory from die interconnects, low-precision matrices and rack scaling, including uncertainty.

related.title: NVIDIA DGX H100 八 GPU 伺服器
related.why: 可遷移張量、數值誤差及計算／記憶體收支；算子、精度與資料歸納假設需重設。
related.whyEn: Tensor, numerical-error and compute/memory accounting transfer while operators, precision and data assumptions must be respecified.
related.transfer: 可遷移張量、數值誤差及計算／記憶體收支；算子、精度與資料歸納假設需重設。
related.transferEn: Tensor, numerical-error and compute/memory accounting transfer while operators, precision and data assumptions must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課針對SIMT、Transformer Engine 與非同步記憶體；NVIDIA DGX H100 八 GPU 伺服器改以雙 CPU、NVSwitch 與計算／儲存網路分層為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on simt, transformer engine and asynchronous memory; NVIDIA DGX H100 eight-GPU server centers on dual cpus, nvswitch and compute/storage fabric layers, so geometry, boundaries and product values cannot transfer unchanged.
practice: 對照Hopper warp與SM與H100與主記憶拓撲，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。
把本課假想算例移到NVIDIA DGX H100 八 GPU 伺服器，列出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以工作能耗與精度為起點，設計一項能區分「SIMT、Transformer Engine 與非同步記憶體」與「雙 CPU、NVSwitch 與計算／儲存網路分層」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare hopper warps and sms with h100 and host-memory topology and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to NVIDIA DGX H100 eight-GPU server, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from job energy and precision and propose an observation distinguishing simt, transformer engine and asynchronous memory from dual cpus, nvswitch and compute/storage fabric layers, including uncertainty.

history.text: NVIDIA Hopper GPU 架構的公開資料展示SIMT、Transformer Engine 與非同步記憶體的工程脈絡；本課以不同功能層與可驗證輸出重建教學案例，不宣稱取得任何專有製造流程。
